target.title: fix(diagnostics-otel): route shared OTLP endpoints per signal
target.body:
Related: #98886

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where operators enabling multiple diagnostics OTLP signals could send metrics and logs payloads to a traces endpoint when their shared OTLP endpoint already ended in `/v1/traces`.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared diagnostics OTLP endpoint fallback now rewrites only a trailing OTLP signal segment to the requested signal path, while explicit traces, metrics, and logs endpoint overrides remain exact per-signal routes. The OpenTelemetry gateway docs now describe that split so shared endpoints and exact signal overrides stay predictable.

## User Impact

Operators can point `diagnostics.otel.endpoint` or `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` at a signal-qualified OTLP HTTP URL and enable traces, metrics, and logs without misrouting non-trace payloads. Existing explicit per-signal endpoint overrides keep their current exact behavior.

## Evidence

- Focused proof: `PATH=/Users/harjothk/.nvm/versions/node/v22.19.0/bin:$PATH node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/diagnostics-otel/src/service.test.ts` passed with 1 file and 97 tests.
- Whitespace check: `git show --check HEAD` passed.
- Autoreview: `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main` passed clean with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Dependency contract checked locally: OpenTelemetry Node exporters route HTTP OTLP traces, metrics, and logs with `v1/traces`, `v1/metrics`, and `v1/logs`; the shared OTLP endpoint fallback appends the requested signal resource path for non-specific endpoints.
- AI-assisted: yes. Codex implemented and tested this change, and I understand the code path and remaining proof gap.
- What was not tested: no live Langfuse or collector run was executed; validation is source-level service startup/exporter URL proof plus dependency-source inspection.
